column1: # unit-464order — MY hand read of TWO axes over the same thirteen CROSS-STATE rows, done off
# `slice1.13rows-at-1411a7d7.out` (a recorded slice of the PINNED source at 1411a7d7), filed as its
# own commit BEFORE `grade-order.mjs` exists.
# THIS FILE CARRIES NO `subkind5` COLUMN AND NO c1..c4 COLUMNS. The grader joins my published
# five-way label out of MY OWN `unit-464reach-2026-11-02/HAND-READ-13.tsv` and Theseus's criteria
# out of HIS `unit-464subkind-2026-11-02/HAND-CRITERIA-13.tsv`, both on (file,line,id), so no
# departure can come from my re-typing either. [[feedback_slicing_the_inputs_but_retyping_the_verdict]]
# AXIS A — THE COMPARISON. Exactly one value per row; this is a partition by construction, so no
# order is needed to apply it.
#   conjunctive  the two states are never operands of ONE comparison (each is compared to a literal)
#   delta        there IS one state-vs-state comparison and the leg asserts the two DIFFER
#   identity     there IS one state-vs-state comparison and the leg asserts the two are the SAME
# AXIS A IS READ THROUGH THE OPERAND DERIVATIONS, NOT OFF THE PREDICATE'S OPERATORS. `:161` is why:
# its predicate is `preCtrl.code === 0 && preCtrl.verdict === 'GREEN' && preCtrlMatches === 5` —
# every top-level operand is compared to a LITERAL — but `preCtrlMatches` is itself
# `preCtrl.gateLines.filter((l, i) => l === rec6Lines[i]).length`, a live-vs-frozen identity count.
# A token-adjacent reader sees `=== 5` and calls that row `conjunctive`. It is one of the two hazard
# rows. [[feedback_an_adjacent_token_pattern_cannot_reach_a_wrapped_call]]
# AXIS B — THE FIGURE. Exactly one value per row.
#   immovable     no commit can change the compared figure (both anchors fixed, and the cure's own
#                 diff over the subject does not touch the compared literal)
#   movable       a cure to the subject moves the figure
#   history-keyed an anchor is a recency SELECTOR, so ANY commit touching the path moves the figure
# `history-keyed` is Theseus's axis from his 2026-11-02 WORK §1 ("literal-anchor vs
# selector-anchor"), narrowed to the figure rather than to the anchor so that `:88` — whose POST
# anchor IS the worktree but whose compared figure is a fixture-path literal 0 of 83 changed lines
# of the cure touch — reads `immovable` and not `movable`.
